board: Ground: verified local resources, Harlem, NY

checks.result: Confirmed on the provider page: free hot meals at 252 West 116th Street, community meal Monday, Wednesday, and Friday 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., older adult lunch Monday to Friday at midday.
Confirmed on the provider page: free farmers market style produce distribution at 252 West 116th Street, second and fourth Tuesdays, 10:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m.
Confirmed on the provider page: food pantry distributes food Tuesday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., with a daily cap of 125 guests, and the page lists 91 Claremont Avenue.
Confirmed on the provider page: Sunday soup kitchen at 1047 Amsterdam Avenue at 112th Street, breakfast at 10:00 a.m. and lunch at 12:30 p.m., with no eligibility restrictions.
Confirmed on the provider page: community health center at 1824 Madison Avenue, primary care Monday and Thursday 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. and Tuesday, Wednesday, and Friday 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
Confirmed on the provider page: affordable health services at 264 West 118th Street, hours Monday to Thursday 8:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. and Friday and Saturday 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

Confirmed on the provider page: Harlem Drop-In Center at 209 West 125th St, 2nd Floor, for youth experiencing homelessness, with hot meals, showers, and clothing. The page states no hours for the center.

Confirmed on the provider page: the NYC 311 warming centers page lists NYC Health + Hospitals/Harlem at 506 Lenox Avenue as a warming space, open 24/7. The page notes warming centers may be activated during periods of extreme cold.

Confirmed on the City of New York ACCESS NYC page for Runaway and Homeless Youth Drop-In Centers (NYC Department of Youth and Community Development): phone charging is listed among the services at these centers, for youth ages 14 to 24, no appointment needed; the page names Safe Horizon Streetwork Harlem at 209 West 125th Street, New York, NY 10027, phone (212) 695-2220, hours 10 a.m. to 6 p.m., closed Wednesdays.

expiry_rule: Every listing expires 30 days after the date it was verified. A listing past its expiry is shown as stale, never silently.
